method: Static PEReader/Portable PDB metadata, source checksums, embedded-source extraction, full per-method body hashes, and file SHA256. No measured assembly loaded or executed.
stage: Pre-measurement payload audit. This report does not assert completed formal runs. Formal plans must bind the listed R6 payload SHA256 values.

build_verification_binding.scope: Rehashed all source and artifact paths listed in the existing build/smoke receipt. The static audit does not rerun tests or player validation.

source_changes_from_baseline.change: Only accepts validate/contracts operation names and adds a contracts-guarded validation helper after existing semantic preflight and before existing GC/warmup. R6 expands the reported contract count and scope inside that excluded branch.
Correctness-only helper absent from baseline; R6 adds mixed dependency and boundary checks. It is excluded when formal operations omit contracts.
Embedded Unity script registration includes correctness helper types. Sources are extracted and checksum-verified.

timing_boundary: Removing the two explicitly identified validation additions reproduces baseline BenchmarkPlayer.cs exactly. Fixture creation, preflight, one warmup, forced-GC locations, operation-only timer, allocation accounting and result validation are unchanged. Formal plans must omit contracts/validate operation groups.
limits: Assembly-CSharp is not byte-identical to baseline or R5: expanded validation code can change metadata tokens, method layout and engine registration. Full raw IL comparisons below preserve those differences and do not establish normalized method equality. PDB-bound source equivalence establishes unchanged timed driver and fixture sources; it does not guarantee identical JIT layout or a performance result.

previous_driver_raw_method_comparison.scope: Full method signature blob, raw IL SHA256 and length, max stack, initialized locals, local signature blob, and exception-region kind/offsets/lengths/filter/catch token. Metadata tokens are not normalized.
